title: Red Hat Security Advisory: java-21-openjdk security update for RHEL 10
description: A critical security update for the OpenJDK 21 packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 addresses multiple vulnerabilities affecting the Java Runtime Environment and Software Development Kit. The update includes fixes for issues related to Kerberos ticket handling, StringBuilder checks, JFR events, loop handling, vector masks, integer compression, JMX connections, Base64 optimization, and TLS client connections. These vulnerabilities could potentially lead to remote code execution and other security impacts. The update is available for various architectures and extended support versions of Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.
